# 3 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> Guide Price £150,000 - £170,000 Situated on Nocton Drive in Lincoln, this three-bedroom semi-detached home offers a practical layout, off-road parking, and clear potential for improvement, making it well suited to first-time buyers or investors. The property is positioned on a quiet residential street and benefits from a driveway to the front, along with a low-maintenance garden area.
